build_BaseTrackerPredictor: build a BaseTrackerPredictor model with configurable correlation levels, radius, and latent dimension for visual tracking
run_BaseTrackerPredictor_forward: run the BaseTrackerPredictor forward pass with query points and feature maps to predict tracked coordinates
